The [[University of Ruuria/Legends|University of Ruuria]] had a '''Human History''' subdepartment during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] was the chair of the subdepartment's [[Pre-Republic era|pre-Republic]] subdivision.
